archived_bootstrap.note: archived paired bootstrap (10000 reps, base seed 20260822); three-seed mean OURS minus BASE unless stated

H1.rule: three-seed mean paired delta has F1 CI lower>0, native Chamfer CI upper<0, and native IoU CI lower>0

H3.rule: three-seed mean 8K-minus-2K F1 CI lower>0, native Chamfer CI upper<0, native IoU CI lower>0

H4.rule: paired mean delta and CI lower bound are both at or above each frozen margin; unavailable verified metric weights yield explicit not_evaluated, never pass

H5.rule: each seed independently has F1>0, native Chamfer<0, native IoU>0 versus BASE

provenance.native_ulip_corrected: H100 reanalysis/ulip_peritem_v1/per_result_ulip_peritem.jsonl — point batch = 1, otherwise the frozen pipeline unchanged
provenance.native_ulip_frozen: frozen column of the same record: point batch = 8, native branches only, quarantined (the batch-sensitive PointBERT kernel in the env that produced it shifted every native branch by roughly -0.06 in cosine)
provenance.ulip_protocol_alignment: The external evaluator (models/evaluators/harness/metric_runtime.py) scores ULIP with xyz = point_bundle['ulip_xyz_8192'].unsqueeze(0) i.e. point batch = 1, one student_prompt per forward, and refuses any bundle that is not centroid-centred with unit maximum radius; its evaluator_config.json pins normalization='centroid then unit maximum radius', 8192 points and the same ULIP_PointBERT checkpoint (sha256 c4833a0b...59627) that the native per-item rerun used. External and per-item-corrected native ULIP are therefore on one protocol and one column; the batch=8 frozen column is native-only and is not comparable to either.
provenance.teacher_geometry: H100 corrected structural metrics occupancy_to_teacher_it / mesh_to_teacher_it / geometry_to_teacher_it; reference branch TEACHER-IT
provenance.teacher_image: PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS computed against the TEACHER-IT render of the same sample, replicate and azimuth; this protocol has no ground-truth image, so these measure agreement with the teacher rather than fidelity to a dataset image
